Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

IS : 11569- 1966 




Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
CERVICAL COLLAR 



( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 



1. Scope — Specifies requirements of cervical collar. 

2. Materials 

2.1 The fabric shall be plain woven and made of cotton or rayon or blend of cotton and rayon. 

2.1.1 The fabric shall be reasonably free from spinning, weaving and processing defects. It 
shall be coloured as agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 

2.2 Sewing Thread — Cotton sewing thread of 98 tex >: 6 ( or 60's x 6) conforming to Variety 
No. 31 of IS : 1720-1978 'Specification for cotton sewing threads ( second revision )'. 



2.3 Eyelets 
revision )\ 



Conforming to IS : 4084-1978 'Specification for eyelets and washers ( sail )( first 



2.4 Filling Material — Conforming to IS : 7933-1975 'Specification for flexible polyurethane foam 
for domestic mattresses'. 

2.5 Fasteners, Hook and Loop Tape — Ends of the collar shall have fasteners, hook and loop tape 
conforming to IS : 8156-1981 'Specification for fasteners, hook and loop tape, synthetic (first 
revision )\ The tape shall have the minimum width of 5 cm and minimum overlap 2'5 cm. Expandity 
of the collar shall be 5 cm. 

2.6 Reinforcement Material — Polyethylene strip shall not be less than V5 mm thick. 
3. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1.

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The cervical collar shall be tailored neatly. The reinforcement strip shall be neatly cut to the 
required size and arranged to form a uniform thickness throughout without any wrinkles or distor- 
tions. This shall be placed in such a way as not to cause lump formation with effect of usage. 

4.2 The cervical collar shall have a very soft feel. When worn shall not give any uncomfortable 
feeling. 

5. Sampling 

5.1 Lot — In any consignment, all the cervical collars produced from the same raw material under 
similar conditions shall constitute a lot. 

5.2 The number of collars to be selected from each lot shall depend on the size of the lot and 
shall be in accordance with col 1 and 2 of Table 1. 

5.2.1 These collars shall be selected from the lot at random and in order to ensure the random- 
ness of selection, procedures given in IS : 4905-1968 'Method for random sampling', may be 
followed. 

TABLE 1 CRITERIA FOR CONFORMITY 
Lot Size Sample Size Acceptance Number 

d) (2) (3) 

Up to 25 3 

26 ,,100 5 

101 ,,150 8 

151 „ 300 13 1 

301 and above 20 1 

5.3 Number of Tests and Criteria for Conformity — All the collars selected at random in accordance 
with col 1 and 2 of Table 1 shall be tested for material (2), shape and dimension (3), workmanship 
and finish (4). A collar shall be considered as defective if it fails to meet any of these require- 
ments. The lot shall be considered as conforming to these requirements if the number of defective 
collars in the sample is found to be less than or equal to the acceptance number. 

6. Marking 

6.1 Each component shall be marked with manufacturer's name, initials or registered trade-mark. 

6.1.1 ISI Certification Mark — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, 
New Delhi. 

7. Packing - As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Cervical collar is an appliance used to restrict or limit motion in cervical region and relieve 
muscle tension.
